d:
Bihar ke mokama se vidhayak anant sinh apni beti ki shahi shadi ko lekar indinon kaphi charcha men hain. isi kari men shadi vale din hone vali ghurdaur pratiyogita ko lekar bhi jamkar praiktis chal rahi hai. ismen koee kasar na rahe isko lekar anant sinh biti rat (10 navanbar) apne paitrik ghar barh ke nadavan ganv pahunche.
